subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the conflicting fork PR before starting any new repair path for this schema mismatch?
rationale: The fix shape is clear, but an open fork PR already claims the exact fix and is not a clean landing vehicle, so automation should not create a competing repair until that candidate is resolved.

options.title: Adopt or replace the fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork candidate, then land a narrow same-repo schema repair with focused global config coverage.

options.title: Wait on the fork PR
options.body: Keep the issue open while the fork author resolves conflicts and enables maintainer edits, accepting that the shipped mismatch remains unresolved.

options.title: Remove the documented key
options.body: If maintainers no longer want the global knob, remove it from docs/help/types instead of accepting it in the schema.
